key.name: capture-shortcut
key.description: Captures every monitor inside GNOME Shell and opens Shotlet's editor, without any prompt. Left unbound while GNOME's own screenshot shortcuts use the same key.

key.name: record-shortcut
key.description: Opens Shotlet's area picker to record a video or GIF, without any prompt; during a recording, stops it.

key.name: fullscreen-shortcut
key.summary: Capture the screen under the pointer
key.description: Captures the monitor under the pointer, then does what Shotlet's after_fullscreen setting says (thumbnail, editor or copy). Left unbound while GNOME's screenshot shortcuts or capture-shortcut use the same key.

key.name: screens-shortcut
key.description: Captures every monitor, then does what after_fullscreen says. Left unbound while GNOME's screenshot shortcuts or capture-shortcut use the same key.

key.name: previous-shortcut
key.description: Opens the editor with the last selection made on this monitor layout already selected. Left unbound while GNOME's screenshot shortcuts or capture-shortcut use the same key.

key.name: window-shortcut
key.description: Outlines the windows; a click captures just that window, with its rounded corners on a transparent background. Left unbound while GNOME's screenshot shortcuts or capture-shortcut use the same key.

key.name: scroll-shortcut
key.description: Select a region, then Shotlet scrolls it and stitches one tall image. Left unbound while GNOME's screenshot shortcuts or capture-shortcut use the same key.

key.name: timer-shortcut
key.description: Captures an area after timer-seconds. Left unbound while GNOME's screenshot shortcuts or capture-shortcut use the same key.

key.name: thumbnail-shortcut
key.description: Shows the floating thumbnail of the last capture or recording again (shotlet thumbnail). Left unbound while GNOME's screenshot shortcuts or capture-shortcut use the same key.

key.name: timer-seconds
key.description: Seconds the self-timer counts down before capturing.

key.name: shotlet-path
key.description: Absolute path of the shotlet binary to start; empty: the one named by io.github.midnattsol.Shotlet.desktop, else shotlet on PATH.
